map.维度对不上是什么原因？: Why do the dimensions not line up?
map.矩阵乘法要求前者的列数等于后者的行数，结果维度为「前者的行 × 后者的列」。常见: Matrix multiplication requires the columns of the first matrix to equal the rows of the second, and the result has the dimensions "rows of the first x columns of the second". A common mistake is reversing the order - multiplying A(2x3) by B(3x4) is legal and gives 2x4, but B times A is not legal at all. Even for square matrices, swapping the order usually changes the result.
